attendance.removeIntro: To correct a mistaken check-in. This reverses any points it earned and revokes any certificate issued from it — the check-in record itself is never deleted, only marked removed, with when and why. The member can check in again later if needed.
attendance.removeEmpty: No one is currently checked in to remove.
attendance.removeConfirmBody: <bdi>{name}</bdi>'s check-in for <bdi>{session}</bdi> will be removed. The check-in record itself isn't deleted — it's marked removed, with when and why. Any points tied to it are reversed with a separate ledger entry, and any certificate issued to them for this session is revoked. This can't be undone automatically, but the member can check in again if needed.

removeError.stale_claims: Your permissions changed — reload the page and try again
removeError.reason_required: Write the reason for removal first
removeError.not_found: There's no active check-in for that member to remove
removeError.unknown: That check-in could not be removed — try again
